SELECT
  t.row_id,
  t.account_id,
  t.event_time,
  t.amount * f.fx_rate AS amount_usd,
  CASE WHEN day_of_week(from_unixtime(t.event_time/1000, 'UTC')) IN (6,7) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_weekend,
  SUM(t.amount) OVER (
    PARTITION BY t.account_id
    ORDER BY t.event_time
    RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
  ) AS amount_7d
FROM tx_rawd6fe8a_1 t
JOIN fx_ratesd6fe8a_1 f ON t.currency = f.currency
ORDER BY t.event_time
LIMIT 5" 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|compatibility\|pip install\|Base URL\|explore it\|^$" | tail -15

tool_input.command:
hops sql --no-verify --catalog delta --schema mlpab8e4286_featurestore "
WITH w AS (
  SELECT row_id, account_id, event_time,
    SUM(amount) OVER (PARTITION BY account_id ORDER BY event_time RANGE BETWEEN 604800000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS win_7d
  FROM tx_rawd6fe8a_1),
s AS (
  SELECT a.row_id,
    (SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM tx_rawd6fe8a_1 b WHERE b.account_id=a.account_id AND b.event_time BETWEEN a.event_time-604800000 AND a.event_time) AS self_7d
  FROM tx_rawd6fe8a_1 a)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_rows,
       SUM(CASE WHEN ABS(w.win_7d - s.self_7d) > 0.0001 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mismatches
FROM w JOIN s ON w.row_id=s.row_id" 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|compatibility\|pip install\|Base URL\|explore it\|^$" | tail -6
tool_input.description: Verify window sum equals self-join over all rows
